8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L6: CoreWeave Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L7: Disciplined Growth at Scale Drives Record Third Quarter Revenue and Expanding Margins
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L8: LIVINGSTON, N.J., – November 10, 2026
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L9: – CoreWeave, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV), The Essential Cloud for AI
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L10: Ⓡ
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L11: , today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L12: "This was a breakout quarter for CoreWeave, with revenue increasing by more than $1 billion sequentially and adjusted operating margins reaching double digits a quarter ahead of plan," said Michael Intrator, co-founder, chairman and chief executive officer of CoreWeave. "Our growth is supported by multiple sources of funding, including financing backed by customer contracts, operating cash flow, and approximately $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits expected in the next three months alone. That financial flexibility positions us to keep delivering the infrastructure and software customers need to build, run, and scale AI."
